question.text: Master-Feeder Structure uses a feeder fund domiciled in an offshore jurisdiction that invests:

answer.text: Into the domestic Master Fund (onshore AIF)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 4.1.3, in Master-Feeder, offshore feeder fund invests into the onshore master fund, which in turn invests in investee companies. **The Trap:** Direct investment by feeder is NOT the structure. **Cross-Exam Context:** Distinct from Parallel Structure. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Charges typically concentrated at master-fund level; feeder has symbolic fees (e.g., USD 1,000).
